trigger.headline: The 10-Year Crossed 5%: the 10-year Treasury yield rose 0.29 points to 5.15%; the dollar hit a one-year high (103.41); bonds fell along with gold (-4.5%).

chain: the 10-year yield jumps 0.29 points in a week to 5.15%
leveraged holders of agency mortgage bonds take book-value losses and pay more to hedge
links.exposure_source: Orchid Island Capital 10-K FY2025, Item 1: its primary business is leveraged investment in Agency RMBS

chain: the 10-year yield jumps to 5.15% and bonds fall

links.exposure_source: Bank of Hawaii 10-K FY2025, Item 7 average balances: about $4.4 billion of taxable held-to-maturity securities yielding 1.77%
